text:
maya: Quick report from onboarding: sampleapp seemed to hang on first bulk import. UX showed "processing" with no stream for ~25s.
jong: Any logs? short paste?
maya: trimmed log:
[2026-04-05T08:02:24Z] INFO start import items=150 concurrency=10
[2026-04-05T08:02:24Z] INFO client:init tokens=0 cap=12 refill_ms=1000
[2026-04-05T08:02:24Z] WARN req(0) -> 429 rate_limited
[2026-04-05T08:02:25Z] INFO queued=22 backoff=1000ms
[2026-04-05T08:02:49Z] INFO first success

felix: Looks like the token-bucket is zeroed at init and all requests queue while auth/kernels warm. Combined with synchronous backoff (no jitter) you get large synchronized retry bursts.
sara: Short-term fixes we should push: 1) sampleapp dev-mode sets optimisticInitialTokens=3 and prewarm=true (perform a tiny embed on startup). 2) add small jitter to initial backoff (+-20%). 3) add retryThrottle config (max concurrent retries) and default it to 4 in sampleapp.
jong: For SDK parity: apply jitter + retryThrottle in JS + Go and expose optimisticInitialTokens with default 0 for prod, 3 for dev. Also ensure retries don't count against active window slots (release before sleep).
maya: Minimal JS snippet I used to test prefill + jitter:
```js
// on init (dev mode)
bucket.tokens = Math.min(bucket.capacity, 3);
function jitter(base){ return base * (0.8 + Math.random()*0.4); }
```
felix: Add CI smoke test: run headless sample import 50 items and fail if time-to-first-successful-request > 15s. Will catch regressions.
sara: Also add Console metric onboarding.first_success and client.retry.429_ratio. That'll let product see field regressions.
devex-bot: Created RED-DEVEX-1355: sdk: optimistic prefill + jitter + retryThrottle + sampleapp prewarm (severity: medium).
jong: I'll open PRs for JS/Go, add unit tests for re-acquire semantics on retry, and a small e2e job for the sampleapp smoke.
maya: Thanks 44d I'll update the quickstart note: "If importing many items, consider prewarm and reduce concurrency or set optimisticInitialTokens in dev."
sara: One more: consider a tiny leaky-bucket smoothing on refill (spread refill over 100ms) to reduce discrete spikes. Put behind opt-in flag for now.
jong: Agreed. Ok I'll create branches and link PRs to RED-DEVEX-1355.
